company.name: Kura AI
company.shortDescription: Kura AI provides a developer platform for building and deploying enterprise-focused AI browser agents using natural language.
company.description: Kura AI provides a developer platform for building, iterating, and deploying AI browser agents that automate interactions with web applications. The company focuses on generative browser automation, enabling developers to define agent behavior using plain natural language instead of traditional scripting. Its framework is designed for enterprise use, incorporating data isolation, client-side encryption based on private key ownership, and full audit trails. The platform uses a hierarchical multi-agent architecture that runs specialized loops to analyze context and execute page logic. This architecture supports use cases such as automated testing, web scraping, data extraction, and other repetitive browser-based workflows. Kura AI targets software teams and organizations that need resilient, maintainable automation for complex web interfaces.
